# Introduction

We compare the m6a sites called from sample 5 (HEK293T cell, https://xsun1229.github.io/camseq-m6a/QC_round3.html) with the camseq paper.

camseq paper: 

[Small-molecule-catalysed deamination enables transcriptome-wide profiling of N6-methyladenosine in RNA](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40247118/)

Data: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE268871

```{r message=F, warning=F}

library(data.table)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)

df_paper_raw <- fread("/project/xinhe/xsun/camseq/pipeline/data/m6a_camseqpaper_PMID40247118.tsv")

DT::datatable(head(df_paper_raw),caption = htmltools::tags$caption( style = 'caption-side: left; text-align: left; color:black;  font-size:150% ;','Several sites reported by camseq paper'),options = list(pageLength = 10) )


print(paste0("Total number of m6a sites reported by the camseq paper (p<0.001, depth >=20): ", nrow(df_paper_raw)))

```


# Comparison 

We vary the read depth (10, 15, 20)/ methylation level (0, 0.05,0.1) / p-value (0.01, 0.001, 0.0001) for our data, then compare the m6a sites with the paper.


```{r message=F, warning=F, fig.height=27, fig.width=12}

READDEPTH_vec      <- c(10, 15, 20)
p_cutoff_str_vec   <- c("0.01", "0.001", "0.0001")
methylation_vec    <- c(0, 0.05, 0.1)

df_paper_raw <- as.data.table(df_paper_raw)
df_paper_raw[, site := paste0(Chrom, "-", Pos)]
df_paper_raw[, methylation_level := Uncon / Depth]

paper_sites <- df_paper_raw$site

# ---- All combinations (fast + tidy) ----
param_dt <- CJ(
  Read_depth = READDEPTH_vec,
  binomial_p = p_cutoff_str_vec,
  methylation_level_filter = methylation_vec,
  sorted = TRUE
)

# Helper to build file paths
make_file <- function(rd, p_cutoff_str) {
  sprintf(
    "/project/xinhe/xsun/camseq/pipeline/workspace_round3/count_sites/pileup/processed_binomp_%s_1n/sample05_with_id_read%d_binomp%s.tsv",
    p_cutoff_str, rd, p_cutoff_str
  )
}

# ---- Compute per combo ----
res_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(param_dt)), function(i) {
  rd  <- param_dt$Read_depth[i]
  pc  <- param_dt$binomial_p[i]
  me0 <- param_dt$methylation_level_filter[i]

  file_ours <- make_file(rd, pc)
  df_ours_raw <- fread(file_ours)

  # normalize methylation once; build site once
  df_ours_raw[, methylation_mepct := methylation_mepct / 100]
  df_ours_raw[, site := paste0(ref, "-", pos)]

  df_ours_f <- df_ours_raw[methylation_mepct >= me0]

  # merge only the needed columns from paper (smaller/faster)
  df_merge <- merge(
    df_ours_f,
    df_paper_raw[, .(site, methylation_level)],
    by = "site",
    all = FALSE
  )

  # plot
  plot_i <- ggplot(df_merge, aes(x = methylation_level, y = methylation_mepct)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Paper methylation level",
      y = "Our methylation level",
      title = sprintf("read depth %s, p-val %s,\n methylation >= %s", rd, pc, me0)
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)

  # summary (avoid divide-by-zero)
  n_filtered <- nrow(df_ours_f)
  n_overlap  <- sum(df_ours_f$site %in% paper_sites)
  pct_overlap <- if (n_filtered == 0) NA_real_ else (n_overlap / n_filtered * 100)

  summary_row <- data.table(
    Read_depth = rd,
    binomial_p = pc,
    methylation_level_filter = me0,
    sites_filtered = n_filtered,
    sites_overlap_with_paper = n_overlap,
    pct_overlap_with_paper = pct_overlap
  )

  list(plot = plot_i, summary = summary_row)
})

# ---- Collect outputs ----
p <- lapply(res_list, `[[`, "plot")
df_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "summary"))

DT::datatable(df_summary,caption = htmltools::tags$caption( style = 'caption-side: left; text-align: left; color:black;  font-size:150% ;','Overlap with the cam-seq paper'),options = list(pageLength = 10) )


grid.arrange(
     grobs = p,
     ncol = 3
)
```






# Conclusion 

Based on the results above, we'll use p < 0.001, depth > 10, and methy. level > 0.05 as thresholds
